purpose_ko: RA·RAC·AEC 신규 독립 계약과 정책 평가 엔진의 남은 정책 결정을 위한 임시 검정 기준. 정식 정책, 계약, 스키마, 실행 승인 또는 유효성 판정을 생성하지 않음.

target: RAC and AEC distinct evaluation contracts

pending_tasks: Resolve the approved RA binding semantics, owner identity, required fields, and registration route.
Resolve exact RAC/AEC owner and declaration bindings, source revisions, entrypoints, and evaluation result semantics.
Resolve independent evaluator and registry interfaces before implementation and registration.
Verify the replacement of current profile consumers before retiring Responsibilities_List.schema.json.

outcome_meanings.PASS: 원본에 고정된 충분한 근거가 해당 임시 기준을 만족
outcome_meanings.FAIL: 확인된 근거가 해당 임시 기준을 위반
outcome_meanings.UNRESOLVED: 승인된 의미 또는 관측 근거 부족으로 결론 보류

pass_if: RA-owned binding meaning is explicit
policy/authority evaluation is not silently transferred to RA
no former Responsibility-Authority schema inheritance

an unapproved owner or authority is fabricated

policy_decisions_open: Approve the RA binding owner, meaning, and responsibility/authority source relationship.
implementation_or_verification_open: Resolve the owner, responsibility, authority, RAC and AEC declarations by identity and revision.
